venues.name: Theory in Biosciences
venues.scope_notes: Conceptual theoretical biology, including novel bioinformatics methods, evolutionary and population biology, genetics and systems biology. Routine stability/sensitivity analysis of biologically motivated differential equations is usually out of scope without convincing conceptual value. OSRI work must remain theoretical, computational or based on existing evidence. AI-assisted research/text use must follow the journal instructions: substantive LLM use is documented in Methods or a suitable section, AI cannot be an author, and human authors retain accountability; ordinary AI copy editing has a disclosure exemption.
